text: If I wanted my prayers to be answered in days instead of years, I would add these 3 divine words. For years, my prayers only brought me more of the same. The same stress, the same lack, the same heartbreak. I felt frustrated and ignored, like maybe there was something wrong with me. Then, I found the tiny piece I was missing. It wasn't praying longer or being more grateful. It all came down to 3 divine words removed from Scripture 1,800 years ago. These words were recited by Jesus and His followers. They allowed them to heal, manifest abundance, and even create miracles. And that is because they are like hitting send on an email. They allow your prayer to reach your Creator instantly. For centuries, nobody knew they were missing, but recently scholars recovered them in a lost prayer found in caves outside Jerusalem. And this lost prayer opens the door for blessings and miracles beyond belief. You go from lack to abundance, from stressed and struggling to deep peace and relaxation, and prayers that went unanswered for years start showing up in days. You can recite the prayer by watching the short video below. It only takes 3 minutes to recite, which means you are just 3 minutes from peace, 3 minutes from abundance, and 3 minutes from everything changing. Because this is the tiny piece you have been missing. So now is your time to receive.
